description: Connect an ADG Events business workspace to manage events, contacts, tasks, trips and reviewed email.

defaultPrompt: Show the connected ADG Events workspace and available actions.
Help me update an event plan after checking its current details.
Prepare an email for my review before sending it.
interface.longDescription: Connect one ADG Events business workspace to work with contacts, deals, event plans and schedules, trips, tasks, registrations, communication drafts, support tickets, notifications and financial summaries. Access follows your workspace settings, role and the capabilities you approve. Send event email through an authorized connected mailbox after reviewing the exact sender, selected event people and message content. Event updates reject conflicting edits. Complete publication, bookings and payments through ADG Events. Household workspaces are not supported. You can revoke a connection from your ADG Events account.

publication.release_notes: 1.2.0 adds event editing with conflict checks and reviewed event email through an authorized connected mailbox. Each connection is limited to one ADG Events workspace and the capabilities the user approves. Sending requires an exact sender, recipient and message preview followed by explicit approval. Status reports distinguish queueing from provider acceptance; provider acceptance does not prove inbox delivery. The package includes the current review walkthrough and five positive and three negative review scenarios. Publication, travel purchases and payments remain in ADG Events.

negative.description: A general science question has no ADG Events workspace intent.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains in two sentences that ice is less dense than liquid water because its crystal structure spaces water molecules farther apart. Makes zero ADG Events tool calls and accesses no workspace.
negative.prompt: Explain why ice floats on water in two sentences.

negative.description: Purchasing travel is outside the ADG Events MCP tool contract.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that travel purchasing is unavailable through this connection and directs the user to the ADG Events booking flow. Makes zero ADG Events tool calls; does not book, charge or create a planning trip.
negative.prompt: Use ADG Events to purchase a round-trip flight to Paris next month.

negative.description: Publishing events and opening registration are outside the MCP tool contract.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that publication and opening registration must be completed in ADG Events. Makes zero ADG Events tool calls; does not create or update an event, open registration or claim publication.
negative.prompt: Use ADG Events to publish an event and open registration now.

positive.description: Identify the connected workspace and current capability availability before acting.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the synthetic ADG Events reviewer workspace and explains consent, role, feature and subscription restrictions. Performs no mutation.
positive.prompt: Which ADG workspace is connected, and what can you do here?

positive.description: Find a synthetic contact and follow pagination for their related deals.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the seeded contact in the connected workspace, follows continuation when present and reports only authorized related deals. Clarifies ambiguous matches.
positive.prompt: Find Alex Example and show all of their deals.

positive.description: Read an event and its schedule before changing its description using the current edit version.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the selected synthetic event and current edit version, updates only its description and reports the saved result. Does not publish or contact attendees.
positive.prompt: Show Review Summit and its schedule, then change its description to Reviewer room layout check.

positive.description: Create an event draft with supplied dates and verify duplicate retry protection.
positive.expected_behavior: Collects required dates before creating. Uses one idempotency key for both attempts, returns the same event ID and creates only one unpublished draft.
positive.prompt: Create a draft event named Review planning session. Ask me for its dates, then retry the same create request once.

positive.description: Preview and explicitly approve the seeded Review welcome draft for Alex Example on Review Summit. That synthetic event person's address must be a dedicated reviewer-controlled mailbox, and the reviewer must have an authorized connected sender.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the saved draft and its current edit version, lists authorized senders and event people, and requests any missing selection. Shows the exact send preview and waits for explicit approval. Uses the approved preview for one send and checks status; distinguishes queued, provider acceptance and inbox delivery.
positive.prompt: Prepare Review welcome for Alex Example on Review Summit. Show me the sender, recipient and exact message; wait for my approval before sending, then check its send status.
positive.tools_triggered: list_communication_drafts, get_communication_draft, list_events, list_email_senders, list_email_recipients, preview_email_send, send_reviewed_email, get_email_send_status
